status: Status: W1 registry (ADR-0189). Ids are permanent once assigned: never renamed, reused or removed. New OM MLS extensions need a row here.
rules: OM uses only values in the RFC 9420 private-use range 0xF000 to 0xFFFF for MLS extension types; they are meaningful to OM Rooms only.
A critical extension must be declared in every KeyPackage's capabilities; a client refuses a group or Add that lacks it.
Extension content never appears in a clear relay header (ADR-0128 rule 7).
